delivery.submitLead: Submitting means you take this version. Own use: what can be checked automatically is checked (target prices, ratings and the like in the write-ups; whether the test results match the idea); if all pass it goes straight into your knowmart shop, otherwise a platform reviewer looks. Public: full platform review; if you tested it yourself, the platform also reruns it once under your account, on your computer, with your model key (events kept in knowbench, you cannot change them); reviewers see results, not raw data.
delivery.toPublicLead: This version is for your own use. Making it public rechecks whether the data you bound to this expert may serve others through it, then goes through full platform review; if you tested it yourself the platform reruns it once on your computer. Buyers keep their version; to change the bound data, make a new version.

listingHint.self: Only you can ask it; data licensed for your use only is fine.
listingHint.public: Others can ask it too; every piece of bound data must allow serving others through an expert.
